system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each Worker is instantiated as an independent agent with its own system prompt and isolated context window
system_prompt_style.note: Per-role prompts plus role-based tool filtering; no code available.

env_context_strategy.note: Workers query DBs/tools; no repo evidence of injected context.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: The Context State (ct) utilizes rolling summaries of tool outputs to keep the LLM context window manageable.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the Artifact State (Dt) tracks the actual files and data objects (SMILES lists, SDF files, docking grids)

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: MCP provides a standardized abstraction layer that unifies discovery, invocation, and error handling.
tool_call_format.note: Format of calls not stated; inferred from MCP tool invocation.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: state-mutating operations (e.g., saving file artifacts via Twrite)
edit_primitive.note: No file-editing primitive described; only artifact write tools.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: These layers are interconnected via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), a standardized bus that abstracts heterogeneous biological tools

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: To manage the heterogeneity of biomedical tools—ranging from local Python scripts and Docker containers to remote cloud APIs—we utilize MCP.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Our control plane operationalizes a bounded plan–execute–reflect loop with replanning, tailored for scientific tasks.
loop_primitives.note: Layer B skill graphs are fixed DAG pipelines.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Layer A implements a Supervisor-Worker Hierarchical Agent System.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: these checkpoints pause execution at critical decision boundaries (e.g., before finalizing a candidate list for synthesis). The interface allows expert scientists not only to approve or reject results but also to perform parameter correction

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Layer B enforces explicit state contracts between nodes in the graph.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: We encode long-horizon drug discovery workflows as Composable Stateful Skill Graphs.
long_term_memory.note: Precompiled reusable skill graphs; not learned across runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: We implement Layer B using LangGraph, allowing us to encode long-horizon workflows as cyclic graphs with persistence and state management.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The loop integrates a reflection mechanism—implemented as a self-correction prompt rather than a separate critic agent—to evaluate the completion status after each step.
self_verification.note: Format adapters validate data programmatically as well.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If a step fails or produces insufficient information, the Supervisor triggers a dynamic replanning routine rather than blindly continuing.
retry_policy.note: Replanning is step-level; no explicit task-level retry count.

rollback.evidence_quote: perform parameter correction or trigger a rollback to a previous state

termination_condition.note: Also early stopping on SUFFICIENT_INFO decision.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Constrained action spaces, schemas, and execution budgets substantially reduce brittle or degenerate behaviors

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: ranging from local Python scripts and Docker containers to remote cloud APIs
execution_isolation.note: Tools federated via MCP servers; execution boundary not specified for the agent itself.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Coverage of integrated computational pipelines, biomedical databases, and real-time web retrieval tools

permission_model.evidence_quote: Strict Mode, used in production, which physically restricts the tool list available to a worker based on its role

tracing.evidence_quote: the system implements Provenance Tracking, recording the lineage of every artifact—capturing which agent, tool, and parameters generated it

replayability.evidence_quote: The sequence of decisions must be deterministic enough to allow human experts to audit the intermediate artifacts Dt and replay the logic.
replayability.note: Paper also notes residual stochasticity prevents exact reproduction.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we proposePharmaBench, a curated benchmark of 88 tasks covering the full spectrum of drug discovery
eval_hooks.note: Benchmark released as HF dataset; no runner code evidence.

guardrails.evidence_quote: We incorporate Format Adapters at the input and output of each node. These adapters programmatically validate and clean data

target_domain.evidence_quote: Mozi, a novel agentic framework designed to reconcile the reasoning flexibility of LLMs with the rigorous, safety-critical demands of pharmaceutical R&D

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We report results for Mozi under two representative model backends

first_release_date.note: Basis: arXiv v1 date; no release tags available.
